name: Szechuan Beef
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical stir-fry portions (≈0.5 lb beef + vegetables yields 3 modest servings); original recipe does not specify servings
Total active prep/cook time conservatively estimated at 30 min based on listed steps (marinating 10-15 min + quick stir-fry); no explicit times given
Oyster sauce classified as shellfish allergen (true) due to typical oyster content; hot pepper sauce left null as type unspecified
Soy sauce and starch (cornstarch) introduce wheat (true) via standard fermented soy/wheat recipes; not confidently gluten-free
Sesame from sesame seed oil (true); egg white (true); no dairy ingredients (dairy-free true)
No tree nuts, peanuts, or fish listed; fish left null due to possible oyster sauce ambiguity
All vegetables, ginger, garlic, sugar, salt, oils, and cooking wine treated as compatible with listed diets where applicable
instructions:
STEP 1 - MARINATING THE BEEF
In a bowl, add the beef, salt, sesame seed oil, white pepper, egg white, 2 Tablespoon of corn starch and 1 Tablespoon of oil.
STEP 2 - STIR FRY
First Cook the beef by adding 2 Tablespoon of oil until the beef is golden brown.
Set the beef aside
In a wok add 1 Tablespoon of oil, minced ginger, minced garlic and stir-fry for few seconds.
Next add all of the vegetables and then add sherry cooking wine and 1 cup of water.
To make the sauce add oyster sauce, hot pepper sauce, and sugar.
add the cooked beef and 1 spoon of soy sauce
To thicken the sauce, whisk together 1 Tablespoon of cornstarch and 2 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your stir-fry until it's the right thickness.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 lb raw beef (flank or sirloin typical for Szechuan); values for 80% lean ground beef equivalent as proxy for stir-fry cut; raw weight used since stir-fried quickly

ingredients.name: Starch
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tbs total cornstarch (2 tbs marinade + 1 tbs slurry); standard cornstarch values

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tbs total neutral cooking oil (2 tbs for frying beef + 1 tbs stir-fry + 1 tbs implied in marinade); assumed vegetable oil

ingredients.name: Green Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 3/4 cup chopped green bell pepper; raw weight

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms; raw weight

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup water (for sauce); no calories or macros

ingredients.name: Hotsauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp hot pepper sauce (chili sauce proxy)
